articles.summary: There are just shy of 12,000 satellites currently orbiting Earth as of June 2024, and that number is projected to rise to over 60,000 by 2030. All of them require batteries to power them when the sun is obscured from view or when they can’t harvest solar energy. This means there is huge demand to develop high-energy batteries to power ...
articles.title: How High-Energy Batteries are Enhancing Satellite Operations
